events.quote: A major change was the acquisition of Widerøe which was finalised at the very start of the year. We warmly welcomed nearly 3,500 new employees to the Group and with the integration going well the acquisition has already yielded benefits.
events.summary: The acquisition of Widerøe was finalised at the start of the year, adding a large number of employees to the Group and already yielding benefits.
events.title: Acquisition of Widerøe completed

events.quote: The Board of Directors intends to propose a profit distribution of NOK 0.60 per share for 2024 at the 2025 Annual General Meeting, to be paid out either through dividend or buy-back of shares.
events.summary: The Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share for the year, paid as dividend or share buy-back, subject to approval from debt instrument holders.
events.title: Board proposes profit distribution to shareholders

events.quote: For Norwegian, there was only a modest increase of one new aircraft for Norwegian from the previous year due to delivery delays from Boeing.
events.summary: Delivery delays from Boeing meant Norwegian added only a single new aircraft during the year and added cost and complexity to operations.
events.title: Boeing delivery delays constrain fleet growth

events.quote: Additionally, we are seeing improvements to the financing terms for our upcoming aircraft deliveries, with Norwegian securing the best-ever terms for the first 25 of our 50 aircraft on order in the Company’s history.
events.summary: Norwegian secured its best-ever financing terms for a portion of its aircraft order book.
events.title: Improved financing terms for aircraft deliveries

events.quote: During 2024, we concluded several key collective bargaining agreements. While these agreements resulted in increased personnel cost across several markets, they also provide improved visibility for 2025 with a reduced risk of industrial action.
events.summary: Several key collective bargaining agreements were concluded, raising personnel cost across markets while reducing the risk of industrial action.
events.title: Collective bargaining agreements concluded

events.quote: The operating result was particularly negatively impacted by the weakening of NOK against USD.
events.summary: The operating result was particularly negatively impacted by the weakening of the Norwegian krone against the US dollar, and the year was affected by weather, air traffic control congestion and cost increases.
events.title: Currency weakness and external disruptions hit results

event:acquisitions_and_disposals.label: Acquisition of Widerøe completed

We warmly welcomed nearly 3,500 new employees to the Group and with the integration going well the acquisition has already yielded benefits."

event:capital_returns.label: Board proposes profit distribution to shareholders
event:capital_returns.note: The Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share for the year, paid as dividend or share buy-back, subject to approval from debt instrument holders. Quote (page 15): "The Board of Directors intends to propose a profit distribution of NOK 0.60 per share for 2024 at the 2025 Annual General Meeting, to be paid out either through dividend or buy-back of shares."

event:fleet_and_engines.label: Boeing delivery delays constrain fleet growth
event:fleet_and_engines.note: Delivery delays from Boeing meant Norwegian added only a single new aircraft during the year and added cost and complexity to operations. Quote (page 3): "For Norwegian, there was only a modest increase of one new aircraft for Norwegian from the previous year due to delivery delays from Boeing."

event:funding_and_rating.label: Improved financing terms for aircraft deliveries
event:funding_and_rating.note: Norwegian secured its best-ever financing terms for a portion of its aircraft order book. Quote (page 3): "Additionally, we are seeing improvements to the financing terms for our upcoming aircraft deliveries, with Norwegian securing the best-ever terms for the first 25 of our 50 aircraft on order in the Company’s history."

event:labour.label: Collective bargaining agreements concluded
event:labour.note: Several key collective bargaining agreements were concluded, raising personnel cost across markets while reducing the risk of industrial action. Quote (page 4): "During 2024, we concluded several key collective bargaining agreements. While these agreements resulted in increased personnel cost across several markets, they also provide improved visibility for 2025 with a reduced risk of industrial action."

event:one_offs.label: Currency weakness and external disruptions hit results
event:one_offs.note: The operating result was particularly negatively impacted by the weakening of the Norwegian krone against the US dollar, and the year was affected by weather, air traffic control congestion and cost increases.
